title: Online Video Converter
description: Convert video formats, extract audio tracks, adjust frame rates, and export videos client-side without any server uploads.

faqs.question: Is my video file secure?
faqs.answer: Yes! The entire transcoding, formatting, and audio extraction is performed directly in your web browser. Your video files are never uploaded to any remote server.

faqs.question: What video files can I upload?
faqs.answer: You can upload any video format that your browser natively supports, including MP4, WebM, OGG, and MOV files.

faqs.question: How does the video-to-audio extraction work?
faqs.answer: The converter extracts the audio track using the browser's built-in Web Audio API, decoding the audio buffer and formatting it as a download-ready WAV or MP3 stream.

educationalContent.whatIsIt: Online Video Converter leverages modern web interfaces, canvas stream capture, and the Web Audio API to manipulate and transcode video and audio formats locally.
educationalContent.howToUse:
1. Select a video file from your device.
2. Choose your target output format: Video (MP4/WebM), Audio (MP3/WAV), or Animation (GIF).
3. Click "Convert Video" and watch the local processing progress.
4. Click "Download Converted File" to save the result.
